hints.title: Cross Product Pairs
hints.text: Every team plays every other team once as the home team and once as the away team.

hints.title: Self Cross Join
hints.text: Perform a cross join between two instances of the teams table.

hints.title: Filter Out Identical Opponents
hints.text: Exclude matchups where the home team is identical to the away team.

hints.title: Cross Join Query Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
select
    t1.team_name as home_team,
    t2.team_name as away_team
from Teams t1
join Teams t2 on t1.team_name != t2.team_name;
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: All permutations of two distinct teams are required in the output.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Output size matches problem output cardinality n * (n - 1).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses cross join with inequality filter cleanly.
